description: Answers home weather questions on the local agent from weather.forecast_home (Met.no), so they never wait on Claude, and opens the #weather pop-up on the Kitchen Echo when the question came from it. Weather for other places still goes to Claude (get_place_weather).

command: (is it|will it|is it going to) (rain|snow) today
(what's|what is|whats) the weather [going to be] [like] tomorrow
(how's|how is|hows) the weather [going to be] tomorrow
(is it|will it|is it going to) (rain|snow) tomorrow
how (cold|warm|hot) (will it be|is it going to be) tomorrow
